method.cli: Sequential subprocess wall time with stdout/stderr captured; includes process startup, JSON IO, diagnostics, and best_cost searches. One warm-up per schedule; randomized round order.
method.core: 7 batches, each >=10ms or 100000 iterations; per-call time from batch duration. Prepared graph and schedule cost computation only; no full schedule validation.
method.caveat: Warm local desktop measurement; no cache flushing, CPU pinning, or background-load control. Corpus schedules are feasible singleton smoke fixtures, not competition submissions.
